question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
-- Correct approach: For each striker who scored >50 in any single match,
-- compute their TOTAL runs across ALL matches, then average those totals
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE total_runs > 50
),
striker_grand_totals AS (
    SELECT sm.striker, SUM(sm.total_runs) as grand_total
    FROM striker_match_runs sm
    JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON sm.striker = qs.striker
    GROUP BY sm.striker
)
SELECT AVG(grand_total) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_grand_totals
